hoods.name: Norridge
hoods.blurb: Home to Harlem Irving Plaza, one of the busiest shopping centers on the Northwest Side, surrounded by tidy brick bungalows and ranch homes. We're in Norridge all the time — same $100 flat rate, zero trip fee.

hoods.name: Harwood Heights
hoods.blurb: One of the smallest, quietest suburbs on our list, tucked right against the city line. Close enough that a Harwood Heights install fits easily into the same day as a Chicago job.

hoods.name: Elmwood Park
hoods.blurb: Built around its distinctive traffic circle at the center of town, Elmwood Park is full of well-kept brick bungalows and two-flats. Same flat-rate install as anywhere else on this list, no suburban upcharge.

hoods.name: Park Ridge
hoods.blurb: A leafy, established suburb just west of O'Hare, full of classic brick homes and a walkable Uptown Park Ridge business district. We're out here often and know the housing stock well.

hoods.name: Niles
hoods.blurb: Home to the Leaning Tower of Niles, a genuine half-scale replica of the Leaning Tower of Pisa built in the 1930s — alongside plenty of solid brick ranch and split-level homes we mount TVs in regularly.

hoods.name: Rosemont
hoods.blurb: A small suburb built around the Donald E. Stephens Convention Center and Allstate Arena, with a mix of hotels, condos, and residential streets nearby. We handle hotel and high-rise logistics without adding to the price.

hoods.name: Schiller Park
hoods.blurb: Sitting right at the edge of O'Hare, Schiller Park mixes residential streets with light industrial areas. Close enough to fit easily alongside a Chicago Northwest Side route.

hoods.name: Lincolnwood
hoods.blurb: A small, well-kept suburb bordering West Ridge, home to the Lincolnwood Town Center and quiet residential blocks of brick ranch homes and newer construction alike.

hoods.name: Des Plaines
hoods.blurb: Home to the original McDonald's Museum — the site of Ray Kroc's first franchised restaurant — and a genuine mix of housing from vintage bungalows to newer subdivisions near the Metra line. We're regulars out here.

hoods.name: Skokie
hoods.blurb: A large, diverse suburb home to the Illinois Holocaust Museum and bordering Old Orchard, with everything from vintage brick homes to newer condo developments. Same $100 flat rate as the rest of our service area.

hoods.name: Morton Grove
hoods.blurb: A quiet, established suburb next to Skokie, full of classic brick ranch homes and mature, tree-lined streets. We serve Morton Grove regularly with the same flat rate and no trip charge.

hoods.name: Golf
hoods.blurb: One of the smallest incorporated villages in Illinois — just a few streets built around the Golf Metra stop. Tiny suburb, same dependable $100 install.

hoods.name: Glenview
hoods.blurb: Home to The Glen, the mixed-use development built on the site of the former Glenview Naval Air Station, alongside plenty of established single-family neighborhoods. We know both the new construction and the older homes well.

hoods.name: Wilmette
hoods.blurb: A beautiful lakefront suburb home to the Baha'i House of Worship, one of only a handful of Baha'i temples in the world, and full of grand vintage homes near the lake. We bring the same careful, professional install here as anywhere.

hoods.name: Evanston
hoods.blurb: Home to Northwestern University, with everything from student housing and vintage courtyard buildings downtown to grand homes along the lakefront. One of the suburbs we serve most regularly.

hoods.name: Northfield
hoods.blurb: A small, quiet, affluent suburb between Winnetka and Glenview, mostly larger single-family homes on wooded lots. We're happy to make the trip — same flat rate, no exceptions.

hoods.name: Northbrook
hoods.blurb: A larger North Shore suburb with a strong mix of corporate offices and established residential neighborhoods, from ranch homes to larger newer builds. We serve Northbrook regularly at the same $100 rate.

hoods.name: Winnetka
hoods.blurb: Home to New Trier High School and some of the most architecturally significant homes on the North Shore, from grand vintage estates to Hubbard Woods bungalows. We treat every home here with the care it deserves.

hoods.name: Kenilworth
hoods.blurb: One of the smallest and most affluent suburbs in Illinois, with a tight cluster of grand historic homes near the lake. A small, exceptional community — we're glad to serve it.

hoods.name: Glencoe
hoods.blurb: A lakefront suburb best known as home to the Chicago Botanic Garden, with beautiful, well-maintained homes throughout. We make the trip north for Glencoe regularly.

hoods.name: Deerfield
hoods.blurb: A North Shore suburb known for its mix of corporate campuses and quiet residential neighborhoods, from mid-century ranch homes to larger newer construction. Same $100 flat rate as our closest Chicago jobs.

hoods.name: Highland Park
hoods.blurb: Home to the Ravinia Festival, Chicago's iconic outdoor concert venue, and a lakefront community full of striking architecture. We bring the same professional, flat-rate install to every Highland Park home.

hoods.name: Highwood
hoods.blurb: A small, historically Italian-American suburb next to Highland Park, known for its concentrated restaurant row along Sheridan Road and close-knit residential streets. Small town, same dependable service.

hoods.name: Lake Bluff
hoods.blurb: A small, charming lakefront suburb just south of Lake Forest, with tree-lined streets and a walkable downtown. We're happy to make the drive — same flat rate as the rest of our service area.

hoods.name: Lake Forest
hoods.blurb: Home to Lake Forest College and Market Square, one of the first planned shopping districts built in the United States, surrounded by grand historic estates. The farthest edge of our service area, still just $100 flat.

hoods.name: Bannockburn
hoods.blurb: One of the smallest and most private suburbs on the North Shore, made up largely of large residential estates near the Tri-State Tollway. We're glad to make the trip for Bannockburn homeowners.
